record_examples.final_record: On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. It created no new Council authority or requirements. In its national explanation, the United States called return to countries of origin or nationality the essential first step. It vetoed S/2020/852 because the draft lacked a reference to repatriation. Russia voted in favour to elaborate existing prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration guidance. It objected that the draft failed to recognize the primary importance of repatriation from Syria and Iraq. In Indonesia's national statement, Dian Triansyah Djani said its draft would guide Member States in developing comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies.
